mud-logging-unit.title: Mud Logging Unit: Configuration & Supply Scope
mud-logging-unit.heading: Define the mud logging unit to be supplied
mud-logging-unit.description: Define a mud logging unit configuration: measurement channels, gas analysis, acquisition, software and documentation. Request an itemized quotation.
mud-logging-unit.intro: Start with the rig application and the complete measurement workflow. This legacy unit record is a reference for configuration review, not a fixed current package.
mud-logging-unit.request: Mud logging unit — new unit or upgrade; request itemized current configuration

sections.heading: Agree the equipment boundary
items: State whether you need a complete unit, an upgrade or selected replacement components. Provide the rig type, destination and intended measurement workflow.
Ask the offer to separate enclosure, acquisition hardware, sensors, gas extraction/analysis, software, utilities and integration work. Inclusion must be explicit.

sections.heading: Resolve the historical configuration before ordering
items: The source mentions Windows 2000 / XP and older communications options. Confirm the offered operating system, supported software version, licence, drivers and remote-data interface with the supplier.

The source contains different enclosure/fire-rating statements and gas-cycle expressions. Obtain the exact offered model, drawing and acceptance method rather than treating those statements as one verified configuration.

Source references to DNV, hazardous-area suitability and leading performance do not establish current approval. Request the certificate schedule and exact assembly identification; confirm installation requirements separately.

sections.heading: Request comparable quotations
items: Supply the required channel list, signal/protocol, gas-analysis scope, power/utilities and environmental conditions. Mark unknown details.
Request an itemized bill of materials, interface drawings, current manuals, calibration/inspection documents and an agreed acceptance plan.
Agree commissioning, training, spares, support responsibility, delivery and exclusions in the offer. No current price, stock or lead time is established by this catalogue.

sls-mud-logging-unit.title: SLS Mud Logging Unit: Configuration Review
sls-mud-logging-unit.heading: Match the SLS record to the proposed unit
sls-mud-logging-unit.description: Review an SLS mud logging unit quotation: acquisition and gas-analysis scope, utilities, software, enclosure documents and acceptance responsibilities.
sls-mud-logging-unit.intro: The historical SLS record describes acquisition, gas analysis and software components. Ask for the current named configuration and included equipment before comparing it with another unit.
sls-mud-logging-unit.request: SLS mud logging unit — request named configuration, documents and acceptance scope

sections.heading: Use the source as a starting configuration
items: The source names an RS-485 acquisition system, gas-analysis components and SLS software. Confirm the exact hardware/software versions and which modules are included in the offer.
Container, channel and analyser values below belong to the legacy catalogue record. Reconfirm them for the ordered unit; do not transfer specifications from the separate Mud Logging Unit entry.

sections.heading: Confirm the package and documentation
items: Provide rig/application, channel list, signal interfaces, gas-handling scope, power/utilities and destination.

Request the offered bill of materials, enclosure drawings, current software/licensing details, manuals and model-matched inspection/approval documents. The source mention of DNV or optional certification is not proof for the offered unit.

sections.heading: Agree integration and acceptance
items: Identify who supplies and connects sensors, sampling equipment, acquisition, host software and remote-data interfaces.
Agree test channels, calibration/inspection evidence, gas-analysis acceptance criteria, training, spares and exclusions before an order.

surface-logging-systems.title: Surface Logging Systems: Equipment & Integration Scope
surface-logging-systems.heading: Build a surface logging system requirement
surface-logging-systems.description: Plan a surface logging system: define sensors, acquisition, gas handling, software and integration responsibilities before requesting a configured equipment offer.
surface-logging-systems.intro: Use this page to scope a surface logging equipment project. The original entry does not identify a complete supplied configuration or a model-specific specification.
surface-logging-systems.request: Surface logging system project — define equipment, integration and acceptance scope

sections.heading: Describe the measurements and workflow
items: List drilling parameters, fluid measurements, gas/sample handling and any formation-evaluation functions required for the project.
Separate equipment procurement from site services. State which functions already exist, which must be supplied and who will operate them.

sections.heading: Define the system interfaces
items: Provide existing sensor models, acquisition inputs, signals/protocols, wiring/connector information and host software details.
Identify power/utilities, mounting, work environment and hazardous-area requirements. A list of catalogue components does not prove a compatible or approved complete system.

sections.heading: Ask for an itemized equipment proposal
items: Request a named equipment/channel list, integration drawings, data mappings and software/licensing scope.
Confirm sampling/analysis components, documentation, calibration/inspection evidence and the acceptance criteria for the proposed package.
State quantity, destination, target date and requested support. Commissioning, training and site work require explicit agreement; current stock, price and delivery are not established here.

超声波液位.heading: Identify this ultrasonic level accessory
checks: Describe the tank geometry, mounting position, liquid surface and required level or volume result. A level reading alone does not establish a calibrated tank volume.
Request the offered instrument drawing, reference point, measurement limits and blind-zone information. Confirm the sensor, transmitter and receiving input separately.
If a wireless link is required, identify the paired transmitter/receiver and acquisition interface; the catalogue designation alone does not establish radio compatibility.

电导率.heading: Match this conductivity accessory to the acquisition system
checks: Specify conductivity units, expected fluid conditions and any temperature-compensation requirement. Do not assume a compensation method from the designation.
Identify the exact probe, transmitter and receiving input; obtain the supply, output circuit and wiring diagram for the offered version.
For a wireless installation, confirm the paired radio components and host mapping separately from the conductivity measurement.

密度.heading: Define the density measurement and installation
checks: Confirm whether the application measures drilling-fluid density or another quantity; a catalogue name is not an installation specification.
Request the sensing arrangement, installation drawing, scaling and reference/calibration procedure for the offered model.
Match power, output, wetted materials and acquisition input to the existing system before selecting a replacement.

温度.heading: Match the temperature probe and receiving input
checks: Describe the medium, mounting or immersion arrangement and required temperature interval.
Request the exact sensing element, transmitter/output, wiring and response requirements for the offered version.
Match materials, installation dimensions and acquisition scaling to the existing system.

压力.heading: Confirm the pressure assembly and measurement basis
checks: Specify gauge, absolute or differential pressure as required, together with medium, process connection and operating conditions.
Request the assembly rating, wetted materials, output and installation drawing for the exact offered version.
A sensor range does not establish the pressure rating or hazardous-area approval of the complete installed assembly.

流量.heading: Distinguish flow trend from absolute flow measurement
checks: State whether you need a relative flow-out trend or a calibrated volumetric flow result. Do not infer an absolute flow range from the designation.
Request the sensing arrangement, installation drawing, transfer relationship and receiving input for the offered item.
Confirm transmitter/receiver pairing, mechanical fit and acquisition scaling before replacement.

扭矩.heading: Define the torque measurement and signal conversion
checks: Identify the measured input and any current-to-torque conversion used by the installed system.
Request the sensor/transmitter model, drive information, scaling and wiring evidence before comparing alternatives.
A catalogue designation does not establish a calibrated torque result or compatible host input.

泵冲.heading: Match the pump-stroke pickup to the pump and input
checks: Provide the pump arrangement, target/sensing geometry and existing pickup nameplate.
Confirm pulse output, power, wiring and acquisition scaling for the exact proposed version.
Request installation and calibration/reference instructions; the designation alone does not establish delivered flow.
